company.name: Instapath
company.shortDescription: Instapath provides digital imaging tools for rapid on-site pathology evaluation to repeat biopsy procedures and increase hospital revenue.
company.description: Over 7 million Americans need biopsy procedures every year, costing over $8 billion; 20% of procedures fail to render an accurate diagnosis. Over 1 million patients have to go through costly, painful repeat biopsy procedures. Instapath makes digital microscopic imaging devices that improve rapid on-site evaluation (ROSE) of biopsies, reducing the need for repeat procedures and increasing operating room capacity and hospital revenue.

aiResearchSummary.text: Instapath is researching systems for delivery and removal of liquid from a sample, as described in 'Systems for Delivery of a Liquid to and Removal of a Liquid from a Sample.' The abstract details a primary device containing the sample, equipped with valves and reservoirs to manage liquid flow. This work supports digital imaging tools for rapid on-site pathology evaluation by enabling efficient sample preparation and handling, highlighting Instapath’s focus on sample management in pathology workflows.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Grant round raised $1,000,000, or 31.65% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $1,225,000, representing 38.77% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,494,777 to $9,275,804, a 2.65x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 58 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (+2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
